data.title: About Greenwood Academy
data.body: Greenwood Academy is a private K-12 school located in the heart of the community. With a dedicated faculty of 120 educators, we provide a comprehensive curriculum that emphasizes critical thinking, creativity, and character development. Our state-of-the-art facilities include science laboratories, a performing arts center, and a full athletic complex. We believe in nurturing the whole student — academically, socially, and emotionally.
